body:
I think the added `file.is_empty()` check could cause some confusion. 🤔 
When `touch main.js` in a directory, I would expect the Node segment to appear.

It looks to me like this is all the function is doing right now.

```suggestion
pub fn has_extension(dir_entry: &PathBuf, extension: &String) -> bool {
```

It looks to me like we'll eventually need all three `find_file::Criteria` to be vectors.
We should probably plan ahead for that. 🤔
Since we won't always need all three criteria, maybe this would be best done as a builder pattern?
This is bad naming again on my part this is actually a `str`. Updated the name to `file_name`, hopefully thats a little clearer?
I'm pretty sure `.python-version` is used by pyenv. This probably shouldn't be removed. 🤔
Feels good to strip this away 🤤

I think accepting an array may be the more idiomatic and performant way to do this.
That's what's done in the `std::process::Command` args API: https://doc.rust-lang.org/src/std/process.rs.html#490-516
Yup your right there is less overhead and we know it's static, good thinking!
